caption: The drawing depicts a large, rectangular wooden cabinet or wardrobe standing on four short legs. The cabinet is shown in a three-quarter view, revealing both the front and one side of the structure. The color of the cabinet is a natural medium brown wood tone, with distinct grain patterns visible throughout the surface. The front contains two tall doors, each of which is divided into three vertical panels, with each panel further subdivided into smaller rectangular sections. The doors have visible metal hinges on the left and right edges, and there is a round, dark-colored knob on the right door near the vertical center for opening. The top of the cabinet has a wide, protruding molding that extends above the body of the cabinet, adding a decorative element. The side of the cabinet also features recessed rectangular panels. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or elements present in the drawing. Near the bottom right of the image, the text "Penn Prince" is written in small, neat script.
title: Wardrobe
